edits.before: The open LEAP Hand has 16 DoF and costs about \$2,000 in catalog parts, roughly an eighth of the Allegro Hand it was benchmarked against <Cite id="leap-hand-2023" />. RUKA's authors put the Allegro at \$15,000 and built a five-fingered hand for under \$1,300 <Cite id="ruka-2025" />. ORCA is an open 17-DoF tendon-driven hand with tactile sensors, under 2,000 CHF in materials <Cite id="orca-hand-2025" />, and the commercial Shadow Dexterous Hand uses 20 motors for 24 degrees of freedom <Cite id="shadow-dexterous-hand-2026" />.
edits.after: The open LEAP Hand has 16 DoF and costs about \$2,000 in catalog parts, roughly an eighth of the Allegro Hand it was benchmarked against <Cite id="leap-hand-2023" />. RUKA's authors put the Allegro at \$15,000 and built a five-fingered hand for under \$1,300 <Cite id="ruka-2025" />. ORCA is an open 17-DoF tendon-driven hand with tactile sensors, under 2,000 CHF in materials <Cite id="orca-hand-2025" />, and the commercial Shadow Dexterous Hand uses 20 motors for 24 degrees of freedom <Cite id="shadow-dexterous-hand-2026" />. Sharpa's Wave, a human-scale five-finger hand with 22 active DoF and high-resolution tactile sensing, is sold through a sales enquiry and lists no price <Cite id="sharpa-wave-2026" />. PSYONIC designed its Ability Hand as a prosthesis and opened it to robotics researchers in November 2022 <Cite id="psyonic-ability-hand-2022" />.

edits.after: Production inference needs an observation assembler, model server, command gate, controller bridge and supervisor, with safety and high-rate feedback below the learned policy. ROS 2 was redesigned from the ground up because ROS 1 lacked production-grade features <Cite id="ros2-science-robotics-2022" />, and the [ROS 2 guide](/classical/ros2-for-ml-engineers) defines the interfaces. For the controller bridge, ros2_control is a ROS 2 framework for robot control, including real-time control. Its packages rewrite the ros_control packages of the original ROS to make new hardware simpler to integrate <Cite id="ros2-control-docs-2026" />. In September 2026 Intrinsic released Intrinsic Core, ROS-compatible real-time control, motion planning and Gazebo simulation under Apache 2.0 <Cite id="intrinsic-core-2026" />. The same month, Qualcomm agreed to acquire PickNik, the longtime steward of MoveIt <Cite id="qualcomm-picknik-2026" />.

Pollen Robotics' Grabette (July 2026) is an open-source handheld recorder modelled on UMI that writes LeRobot datasets, with parts costing about €490. Its motorized twin, Gripette (about €120 in parts), is the robot-arm gripper that carries out the learned movements on a real or simulated arm <Cite id="grabette-2026" />.
